decisions.statement: The closure is answered here rather than read out of a record.
A predicate is named by its slug rather than by its path.
A call naming no predicate is refused naming every predicate there is.
A predicate no page carries is refused rather than followed.
Every word after the predicate is a seed.
A seed is a path said from the repository root.
A seed the checkout holds no file at is refused rather than closed over.
Whether a seed names a file is settled before the measuring opens.
A reader of bodies is handed in whichever way the predicate is followed.
The processor time is this run's own together with the children it reaped.
The memory is what this run added over the memory resident when it opened.
A run that noted no high-water mark draws its memory as `-`.
How many seeds a closure started from is said beside what that closure cost.
How many nodes and how many edges a closure took in are said the same way.
No figure here is shared out over what the closure took in.
No figure here is judged against a limit.
An argument this command does not take is refused.

definition: the command saying what answering one predicate closure cost in processor time and memory
